{{Short description|Jewish mathematician, astronomer, grammarian, and physician in Mantua}}
'''Mordechai ben Abraham Finzi''' ({{Langx|he|מרדכי בן אברהם פינצי}}, {{circa}} 1407–1476 in [[Margravate of Mantua|Mantua]]) was a [[Jew]]ish [[mathematician]], [[astronomer]], grammarian and physician in [[Mantua]].<ref>{{cite journal|first=Moritz|last=Steinschneider|title=Zur Geschichte der Uebersetzungen aus dem Indischen ins Arabische und ihres Einflusses auf die arabische Literatur; insbesondere über die Mondstationen (Naxatra) und daraufbezügliche Loosbücher. Berichtigungen, Zusätze und Index zu Band XVIIl und XXIV|journal=Zeitschrift der Deutschen Morgenländischen Gesellschaft|volume=25|year=1871|pages=378–428}}</ref>

==Work==
Finzi's astronomical tables were published under the title ''Luḥot'', probably before 1480.<ref>{{Cite Jewish Encyclopedia|url=http://www.jewishencyclopedia.com/articles/6124-finzi|title=Finzi}}</ref> He wrote glosses to [[Profiat Duran|Efodi]]'s Hebrew grammar, ''Ḥesheb ha-Efod''.

He also translated a number of mathematical books into Hebrew, such as a work of geometry under the title ''Ḥokmat ha-Medidah'', and the ''Book of Algebra'' of [[Abū Kāmil Shujāʿ ibn Aslam|Abu Kamil]] under the title ''Taḥbulat ha-Mispar''.<ref>{{Cite Jewish Encyclopedia|url=http://www.jewishencyclopedia.com/articles/10478-mathematics|title=Mathematics}}</ref>
